study type: Mixed-methods (Interrupted Time Series Analysis and Descriptive Qualitative Study)
outcome: Delays to provision of intrapartum care
cohort: The study included data from 36,444 childbirths involving women who gave birth in 15 public hospitals in the Sidama Region, Ethiopia, between March 2019 and August 2020.
finding: The study found significant increases in the incidence rates of caesarean sections and instrumental vaginal births during the first 6 months of COVID-19, and identified barriers, delays, and inadequate COVID-19 preventive measures as contributing to increased neonatal and maternal deaths.
mod_finding: The incidence rates of caesarean sections and instrumental vaginal births significantly increased in the first 6 months of COVID-19.
